xmldoc.short_description: Create table UI component (App Designer style).

description.p: t = uitable creates a table component. Data accepts numeric, logical, or cell arrays. Properties: ColumnName ('numbered' or cell), RowName, ColumnWidth, ColumnEditable, ColumnSortable, ColumnFormat, RowStriping, Selection/SelectionType/Multiselect, DisplayData (read-only). Callbacks: CellEditCallback (event: Indices, EditData, NewData), SelectionChangedFcn.

example_item.example_item_description: Captured UI component for the help image.

example_item.example_item_data: f = uifigure(); t = uitable(f, 'Data', magic(4), 'ColumnName', {'A', 'B', 'C', 'D'}, 'ColumnEditable', true(1, 4));
